observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a diesel engine valve cover clearly marked 'DAF 24 VALVE', with visible wiring, turbo housing, and oily/dirty surfaces.
Photo 1: Wider yard shot showing the same type of engine partially covered by a tarp, surrounded by other stripped engines and gearboxes, sitting on bare ground outdoors.
Photo 2: Another angle of the same DAF engine among a row of similar used engines in an open yard, covered with tarps, visible rust and grime on surfaces.
No engine running, no oil dipstick check, no compression test, and no video or sound evidence in any photo.
Engine is a bare block/head assembly without visible mounting to a chassis, transmission, or full wiring harness - appears to be a stripped take-off unit from a salvage yard.

claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine
claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show visible grime, oil residue, and dust typical of a used/salvaged engine, not a freshly cleaned unit.

claims.claim: In excellent condition and ready for work
claims.evidence: No running video, compression test, or oil check shown; engine sits disassembled in an open yard among other stripped units.
No performance or running proof provided in any photo.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (cracked block, worn bearings, etc.)
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting and running, ideally with sound and visible exhaust/smoke color.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running, for parts/rebuild only

risks.risk: Missing accessories (turbo, injectors, alternator, starter, wiring harness) that are essential for installation
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos showing all sides of the engine including intake/exhaust manifolds and electrical connectors.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, requiring additional parts purchase

risks.risk: Corrosion or water damage from prolonged outdoor storage uncovered by tarp
risks.proof: Close-up photos of internal components (cylinder bores, crankshaft) and storage history.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case assuming surface corrosion may be internal too

risks.risk: No proof of origin or legal import documents (customs/Tokunbo papers) for a heavy truck engine
risks.proof: Photo of import/customs documentation or engine number matching papers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as undocumented, higher resale risk

risks.risk: Engine may not match the specific trailer head model needing repair (compatibility)
risks.proof: Photo of engine ID plate with full model/serial number and chassis compatibility list.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic match only, not guaranteed fit

proof_requests: Video of the engine running with audible sound and visible exhaust.
Clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate for exact model identification.
Photos showing all sides of the engine including turbo, injectors, and wiring harness.
Any available import/customs documentation proving legal origin.
Recent photos without tarp covering, showing current storage condition.
response.reason: The engine is identifiable as a DAF 24-valve heavy truck diesel engine, visually confirmed in two photos, but shows no proof of running condition or completeness, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly incomplete used engine; the closest comparable heavy truck diesel engines in the list are the Iveco Eurocargo (same oyo market) and the larger Caterpillar industrial diesel engines.
